definitions.explanation: A swimming stroke performed face-down with simultaneous arm movements that pull water toward the chest and a frog-like kick. The slowest of the four competitive strokes but efficient for recreational swimming.

examples.japanese: {平泳|ひらおよ}ぎは{初心者|しょしんしゃ}でも{泳|およ}ぎやすい。
examples.english: Breaststroke is easy to swim even for beginners.

examples.japanese: {平泳|ひらおよ}ぎで100メートルを{泳|およ}いだ。
{平泳|ひらおよ}ぎのフォームを{直|なお}したい。
examples.english: I want to fix my breaststroke form.

notes:
THE FOUR COMPETITIVE STROKES:
・{平泳|ひらおよ}ぎ (breaststroke) - slowest but energy-efficient
・{背泳|せおよ}ぎ (backstroke) - swum on back
・バタフライ (butterfly) - most demanding
・クロール/{自由形|じゆうがた} (front crawl/freestyle) - fastest

TECHNIQUE:
・{蛙足|かえるあし} (frog kick)
・{キック|きっく} (kick)
・{プル|ぷる} (pull/arm movement)
・{息継|いきつ}ぎ (breathing)

COMPETITIVE EVENTS:
・50m, 100m, 200m {平泳|ひらおよ}ぎ (individual events)
・{個人|こじん}メドレー (individual medley - IM)
・メドレーリレー (medley relay)

HISTORY:
・The oldest known swimming stroke
・Japan has produced many Olympic medalists in {平泳|ひらおよ}ぎ
・{北島|きたじま}{康介|こうすけ} won gold in 2004 and 2008 Olympics

COLLOCATIONS:
・{平泳|ひらおよ}ぎで{泳|およ}ぐ (to swim breaststroke)
・{平泳|ひらおよ}ぎを{習|なら}う (to learn breaststroke)
